scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-degen-inc
scripts.test: node rules.test.mjs && node functions.test.mjs && node app.test.mjs
scripts.test:emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-degen-inc "npm test"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth,storage --project demo-degen-inc "node functions.test.mjs"
scripts.test:app: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth,storage --project demo-degen-inc "node app.test.mjs"
